claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_area_overlap_window
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The dispel-darkness clause fires when Daylight's area spatially overlaps an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower. No existing OngoingTrigger variant covers spell-area-to-spell-area spatial interaction. The v4 window atoms (turn_start_window, on_creature_enters_area, post_action_window, etc.) are all creature-action or creature-movement scoped — none model continuous or one-shot spatial intersection between two spell areas.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeChoice<Attachment> in ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Daylight offers two mutually exclusive attachment modes chosen at cast time: (1) a 60-foot-radius Sphere originating from a point within range, or (2) a 60-foot Emanation originating from a targeted object that is not worn or carried. The ongoing_effect family carries a single Attachment field. No CastTimeChoice wrapper over Attachment exists in the surface; CastTimeEffectModeChoice only applies inside direct-phase effect bundles.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object.
